name: Code Graph
description: Ask about this workspace's code and get the real answer, not a guess. Code Graph indexes every repo here into one searchable graph of symbols, call paths and files, then hands any agent on this tenant a `codegraph_explore` tool that returns the verbatim source of the symbols that matter plus who calls them — one call instead of a dozen greps. The index follows your edits as you make them, so the answer is never stale.

skills.description: What Code Graph indexes across the workspace's nested repos, which MCP tools it exposes and how the HTTP bridge gets them onto aw-gateway, how to force a reindex, and what to check when a query looks stale.

index_root.description: Root directory indexed by CodeGraph. One index covers the root repo and every nested repo named by include_ignored.

include_ignored.description: Gitignore-style patterns naming gitignored directories whose embedded git repos get indexed anyway, written to codegraph.json at index_root. The workspace's own .gitignore excludes /repos/, so without this the nested repos there are invisible to the index — 80 of them on this workspace, measured 2026-10-05.

native_watch.description: Let the MCP server's own file watcher keep the index current in near-real-time. Turn it off to fall back to a periodic `codegraph sync` tick instead (see reconcile_interval_s) if the watcher ever costs too much CPU or runs into the host's inotify watch limit.

reconcile_interval_s.description: How often (seconds) to run a low-priority `codegraph sync`. Only used when native_watch is off — with the watcher on, no polling tick is registered at all.

mcp_tools.description: Which CodeGraph MCP tools to expose. CodeGraph itself only lists `explore` by default; this allowlist re-enables the rest. Short names (`explore`) or long (`codegraph_explore`) both work.

apps.reason: This app's MCP tools reach agents as an HTTP upstream registered in its own mcp.json, which the MCP Gateway app discovers by scanning installed app folders.
